title: Tab And Locator Color
description: GUI-based Tab & Locator color sync for better player visibility
body:
🎨 TabAndLocatorColor

Customize your TAB list colors and Locator Bar colors with an easy-to-use GUI!

Originally ported from the Fabric mod version and expanded with additional Paper server features.

---

✨ Features

🎨 Color Customization

✅ Customize TAB list colors

✅ Customize Locator Bar colors

✅ Automatic color synchronization

✅ 16 base colors

✅ Advanced HEX color palettes

✅ Personal color saving

---

📋 TAB Display Modes

Choose how your color appears in the TAB list.

🔹 SYMBOL

- Colored symbol only

🔹 NAME

- Colored player name only

🔹 BOTH

- Colored symbol and player name

---

🖥 GUI Modes

🔹 SIMPLE

- Fast 16-color selection

🔹 ADVANCED

- Base colors + HEX color palettes

When Team Mode is enabled, the GUI automatically switches to simplified team color selection.

---

📡 Status System

Show your current activity directly in the TAB list.

Available statuses:

🔸 AFK

🔸 Working

🔸 Streaming

Only one status can be active at a time.

---

👥 Team Mode

Perfect for events, mini-games, and community servers.

✔ 2 Teams

✔ 3 Teams

✔ 4 Teams

✔ Balanced player distribution

✔ Randomized team assignment

✔ Automatic team colors

✔ Personal colors restored when Team Mode is disabled

⚠ By default, Team Mode commands are administrator-only.

---

🌍 Multi-Language Support

Included languages:

🇺🇸 English

🇯🇵 Japanese

🇩🇪 German

🇫🇷 French

🇪🇸 Spanish

🇧🇷 Portuguese (Brazil)

🇮🇹 Italian

🇷🇺 Russian

🇰🇷 Korean

🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese

---

🎮 Player Commands

Open GUI

/lc gui
/locator gui

Reset Color

/lc reset

Show / Hide TAB Symbol

/lc symbol show
/ lc symbol hide

Status Commands

/lc status afk
/lc status working
/lc status streaming
/lc status clear

---

🛠 Administrator Commands

Open another player's GUI

/lc gui <player>

Change another player's color

/lc set <player> <color>

Reset another player's color

/lc reset <player>

Manage another player's symbol

/lc symbol <player> show
/lc symbol <player> hide

Team Mode

/lc team true
/lc team false

/lc team set 2
/lc team set 3
/lc team set 4

Reload

/lc reload

---

🔐 Permissions

Basic Access

locator.use

Team Access

locator.team

Administrator Access

locator.admin

---

⚙ Example Configuration

gui-mode: SIMPLE

tab-display-mode: SYMBOL

allow-non-op-team-commands: false

---

✅ Compatibility

Tested on:

- Paper 1.21.6

- Paper 1.21.7

- Paper 1.21.8

- Paper 1.21.9

- Paper 1.21.10

- Paper 1.21.11

- Paper 26.1

- Paper 26.1.1

- Paper 26.1.2

---

💡 Notes

✔ Compatible with GeyserMC and Floodgate

✔ Fabric Mod and Paper Plugin versions are maintained separately

✔ Team Mode automatically restores personal colors when disabled

✔ Perfect for SMP, community, event, and mini-game servers
